title: Maa Kehti Thi Asghar
body:
Maa kehti thi asghar
[Haaye asghar, haay haay asghar] ×3
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×3
Royi hu bhare ghar ko, muje tum na rulaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Tu bol nahi sakta hai, kya mangega paani] ×2
Ay nehr mere laal ko, tu paani pilaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Talwaar utha sakte nahi, tum mere beta] ×2
Tum teer-e-tabassum hi ko hathyaar banaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Maydan me barsaat hai teero(n) ki meri jaan) x2
Ay laal mere teero(n) se, tum khud ko bachana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Aah nad-e-ali dam karoo(n) gardan pe teri mei) x2
Hai radde balaa ke liye, nuskha ye puraana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
(Sunti hu(n) lagaa teer gale par tere beta) x2
Ye zakhme guloo khuld mei, daada ko dikhana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Maloom tha mujhko ke tumhe pyaas hai kaysi] ×2
Marne ke liye paani ka, karte the bahaana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
("Rehan" dua karta hu(n) nohay ke sile me) x2
"Shabbir" ka shaair hi, kahe mujhko zamana
[Maa kehti thi asghar mere ghar lawt ke aana] ×2
[Haaye asghar, haay haay asghar] ×3
